title: Crippling the Fleet
description: Rey and Ben lie on the floor of the citadel in front of a rejuvenated Emperor Palpatine. The emperor marvels at his own rebirth as he casts Ben Solo, the last Skywalker, down a nearby chasm. The Sith Eternal cultists chant around the gloating Palpatine, as he sends a ripple of Force lightning up into the sky!
